definitions: An idiom used to express that something is beyond repair or improvement, often implying that the situation or item is inherently flawed or broken.
To be unable to correct a problem or make something better, suggesting a permanent or intractable issue.
examples: The old car is so rusted, you can't fix it.
Their relationship has too many deep-seated issues; you can't fix it.
The system is fundamentally broken, you can't fix it with minor adjustments.
